title: Coach King's Golden Test
summary: Coach King challenges Vektor to an advanced mate-in-three puzzle to earn his next training rank.

title: Park Blitz Showdown
summary: During a lively blitz game at the park against Bishop Blaze, Vektor spots a hidden mate-in-three sequence and needs your help to finish it.

title: Grandma Queen's Cookie Challenge
summary: Vektor visits Grandma Queen's cozy bakery and must solve an advanced mate-in-two puzzle as Black to win her famous berry cookies.

title: The Rainy Day Riddle
summary: Trapped indoors by rain, Vektor and Pip discover a hidden glowing chessboard that needs a four-move victory.

title: Pip's Homework Rescue
summary: While dreaming of the World Championship, Vektor spots his little friend Pip struggling with chess homework and needs the viewer's help to find the winning move.
